  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  July 09, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Chamber, 9th Floor. On July
09, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, Deputy City Clerk Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License Committee
on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on July 01, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Lucy Treadway / Partnership with Adrew Fiscella to host a Wood Cup World Cup Watch
  Party Event on Market St. between Manchester Blvd, and Queen St, Public Property, on
  Friday July 10, 2026, from, 10:00 a.m to 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO: Approval for a one (1) day event on Market Street between Manchester Blvd
  and Queen St. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant
  is responsible for the ABC event license, crowd control, and event cleanup. Subject to all
  applicable IMC regulations, Applicant shall staff this event with three (3) uniformed
  professional / licensed security guards. All security personnel shall wear reflective vests to be
  readily identifiable to attendees or the general public. Security guards shall be deployed to
  where the alcohol is being served to prevent underage alcohol consumption and the
  overserving of obviously intoxicated persons. Applicant shall provide an approved ABC one-
  day permit. Police and TCOs staffing will already be on site. The IPD watch commander
  will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility will be provided as time permits. Adhere
  to all local, state, and federal laws; Must receive approval from the businesses by 3 p.m.
  on July 10, 2026. Maintain the site at all times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly
  immediately at the end of the event. Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety
 Permits & License Committee  July 9, 2026

  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 0291867)

Item #2:  Diana Ramos, on behalf of WSS to host a WSS Inglewood World Cup / Back toSchool
  Event at 3000 W. Century Blvd, Private Property on, Saturday, July 11, 2026, from, 1:00
  p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Approval for a on (1) day event within the WSS parking lot. Applicant is
  responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Applicant to hire two (2) Police Officers and
  a minimum of eight (8) professional-licensed security guards for public safety and traffic
  control. All security staff shall wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management
  reasons. There shall be NO vehicular movement in the area of pedestrians, and a vehicle
  barrier or support barrier shall be in place at the driveway/parking lot entrance off of Crenshaw
  Blvd., and between the south and east parking lot. Conditions for amplified sound: Manage
  noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact of the
  person in charge of sound and acoustics volume control; No recommendations needed for Fire
  Approval; Applicant must have four (4) bike racks to secure the event area; Maintain the site
  at all times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No.0291810 )

Item #3:  Judith Wilson on behalf of HJ New Way Recovery, Inc. to host a Food Drive Event at 8722
  Crenshaw Blvd, South Parking Lot, Private Property, from Thursday, July 23, 2026, from
  12:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m.; Thursday August 27, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m.; Friday,
  September 25, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m., Thursday, November 19, 2026, from
  12:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. nd Thursday, December 17, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m,
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a five (5) time event within
  private parking lot. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures; Applicant to hire a minimum of three (3) professional-licensed security
  guards for the safety of attendees and for traffic control. One security shall be at the entrance
  of 88th street to serve as a traffic guide for vehicles entering through Crenshaw Blvd., one
  security shall be assigned to the entry, and one to the exit to manage the number of vehicles
  and traffic flow in the lot. Security staff shall wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management
  reasons. Applicant shall ensure traffic cones and directional signage are in place in the parking
  lot. No blocking traffic or traffic cones on Crenshaw Blvd. Applicant may use an “off-duty” law
  enforcement officer that is part of their organization in lieu of the security guards; No conditions
  for Code Enforcement; No additional recommendations needed for Fire Approval; PBWS
  Department approves Ingress / Engress, someone must supervise all vehicles; Maintain the
  site at all times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.0272033)

Item #4:  Corey Stiver on behalf of The Cypher Spot Inc to host the Cypher Spot 10 year Anniversary
  Celebration Event at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr. Park (Amphitheater) Public
  Property; on Sunday, August 02, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park.
  Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park. Applicant is responsible for crowd control
  and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations, Applicant to hire a minimum of six
  (6) professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees. A male / female security
  team or appointed monitors shall monitor the restroom to deter any outside lewd conduct
  activity. All security staff shall wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management
  reasons. There shall be NO alcoholic beverages or smoking permitted during this event. The
  IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility will be provided as
  time permits. Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and
  IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact for the person in charge of sound and acoustics
  volume control; No additional recommendations needed for Fire Approval; Maintain the site at
  all times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.0291796)

Item #5:  Cinder Eller Kimbell on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host an Inglewood Police
  Department National Night Out 2026 Event between Grevillea Ave and Queen and Regent,
  Public Property, on Tuesday, August 04, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. Approval for a
  one (1) day event on Grevillea Ave between Queen and Regent. Subject to Public Works
  approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event
  cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; There will be police officers-personnel at
  this event (personnel TBD). There will be three (3) TCO's deployed to this event for the
  street closures & intermittent traffic control. There will be barriers set up at Grevillea/Regent
  and on Grevillea at the entrance/exit of the city hall employee parking garage. Public Works
  personnel deploying the barriers must be present during the event. This will allow for the
  barriers to be properly moved or relocated in the event of an emergency for the Fire
  Department's access; No recommendations needed for Code Enforcement approval; No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval. Maintain the site at all times, ensuring the site
  is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.181417)

Item #6:  Cammie Park on behalf of RedPeg Marketing to host a One Piece Fest at 1252 District Dr.
  Cosm / Hollywood Park, Private Property, from Monday, August 24, 2026, from 5:00 p.m.
  to 8:00 p.m.; Tuesday, August 25, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m and Wednesday,
  August 26, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT

  TO: Approval for a 3-day event within Hollywood Park Retail and COSM. Subject to Public
  Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant is responsible for crowd control,
  event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures; Must submit for Building Safety plan
  check. rules and regulations, including noise and signage; Applicant to hire one (1) IPD
  Sergeant, six (6) police officers for public safety, and three (5) TCO’s for road closures/traffic
  safety. Applicant shalI hire a minimum of ten (10) professional/licensed security guards for the
  safety of attendees, production staff and equipment; and assist IPD with any potential crowd
  control. All security staff shall wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management
  reasons. There shall be NO vehicular movement in the area of pedestrians, and meridian
  barriers shall be in place. Applicant will be required to contact the Public Works Department
  and coordinate the deployment of Meridian barriers at their expense for the street closures.
  Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time
  permits. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.0291790)

New Business License Renewal Request (s);

Item #7:  Christian Martin on behalf of Martin’s Studio to operate as a Hair/ Barber Shop at 7909 S
  Van Ness Blvd; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City;
  Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies
  of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type
  is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the
  body is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer
  or any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance;Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license
  and any future business license application requests. Motion Carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 0291704)

Item #8:  David Uziel on behalf of A List Worldwide to operate as a Limousine Service at 1227 S.
  La Brea Ave; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and tax fees; All employees
  must have current valid driver’s License, EMT, or First aid/CPR certification.All vehicles
  must have proof of current valid vehicle registration, Class P-Charter Party Permit, and
  vehicle insurance at all times.NO parking, repairs or maintenance of vehicles on city
  streets, sidewalks or alleys.Applicant/owner shall NOT employ or have any 290 PC
  registrants employed or any persons that may pose a threat to the safety of patrons or the
  general public.Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
